items.caption: Hungary’s Tímea Nagy won Olympic individual epee gold in Sydney in 2000 and defended her title in Athens in 2004. After reversing a retirement announcement, she became individual world champion in 2006. This portrait comes from a 2013 ceremony in Budapest.
